slots.purpose: Hero and social share image: a Mauritius lagoon or coastline wedding setting that signals luxury and sets up a practical legal guide.
slots.shot_brief: Landscape 3:2 with room for a title overlay. Ceremony set-up on a beachfront lawn, jetty or terrace at a real, named Mauritian resort, turquoise lagoon and white sand in frame (Le Morne Brabant in the background only if the venue is on the south-west coast and proven), golden-hour light, calm water, white florals, no signage. Couple optional and small in frame. People only from a licensed real wedding with written couple consent (and guest consent if identifiable) recorded in library-index.csv; never AI people, never stock models presented as a real couple. No temples, shrines or religious sites (for example Grand Bassin) used as decoration, and no cultural or religious practice shown unless from a consented real wedding. Source order: venue or resort media kit with written permission (Gmail draft request, never sent by an agent); Mauritius Tourism Promotion Authority (MTPA) media library only if its licence terms cover commercial blog use by a third party ([[VERIFY licence]], record terms, credit and expiry in library-index.csv); licensed premium stock bought by a human and added to the register. Never AI, never a competitor, directory, planner, photographer-blog or search-result image. Location proven by media kit, register row or EXIF, never by appearance.
